construct.name: Environmental Quality Pressure / Tekanan Kualitas Lingkungan
construct.definition: Relative degradation of ambient air, surface water and persistent land/ecosystem condition affecting shared living conditions; official environmental state, not total environmental burden or population exposure.
boundaries: Waste loads and environmental waste-service conditions are distinct supporting candidates; admit only with valid denominator and comparable reporting.

No independence claim between environmental state, socioeconomic structure and IRBI environmental-vulnerability concepts. No explicit duplicate input.

decision.reason: Smallest cross-media official 2023 district-quality summary: all27 valid same-definition observations, nonconstant spread, coherent direction and documented common monitoring framework. Admit only this published administrative construct, not its components or population exposure claims.

official_source.evidence: DLH Jawa Barat, official Galura dataset20488 with producer, approval history and immutable retained2023 response.

reference_2023.evidence: All27 source rows explicitly tahun=2023. Annual administrative index vintage, not a claim of continuous2023 sensing; statutory land sampling can precede calculation year.

comparable_definition.evidence: Single DLH district index panel, Permen27/2021 AnnexVII common district composite. Do not apply different province or2025 formulas.

comparable_unit.evidence: One index-point scale; unchanged published values, not percentages or concentrations.

compatible_geography.evidence: DLH metadata expressly uses BPS2019 district identifiers, matching CIVX registry. No station-to-district assignment or polygon-derived denominator.

environmental_civic_pressure.evidence: Ambient surface-water/air/land condition affects shared environmental living conditions; narrow administrative environmental-quality state proxy.

clear_natural_direction.evidence: Higher official quality means lower environmental-quality pressure; no inversion or score is calculated in this audit.

no_severe_unnecessary_redundancy.evidence: Only one Environment CORE; all embedded media variants are non-additive context or rejected stacks.

valid_denominator_if_rate.evidence: Not a CIVX-derived rate. Published index retained intact; statutory component denominators belong to producer method. No population/area ratio invented.

not_primarily_reporting_intensity.evidence: State index, not reporting-participation count. LKIP2023 PDF41 reports all27 districts monitored across four air-site categories, and PDF44 reports1351 verified water records. Statutory sampling/validation framework provides common basis; this does not independently certify each local sampling log or equal physical exposure representativeness.

not_embedded_in_selected_composite_or_di.evidence: IKLH itself is not an input of retained IRBI or another audited dimension. No water/sanitation access, disease, poverty or IRBI component is added. Land state shares conceptual drivers with IRBI environmental vulnerability; independence is not claimed.
